scope: single registered Turtle strategy; complex prototype validates the long breakout/add/stop lifecycle

breakout_state.usage: prior-bar Donchian breakout, failsafe breakout, trailing channel, and warmup timing
last-profitable-trade filter remains a decision rule; its confirmed update depends on the closed execution outcome

entry_state.usage: strategy uses the last entry/add anchor; execution must supply the confirmed fill price

pyramid_state.usage: maximum adds, add trigger, and same-bar stop suppression
desired pyramid plan remains in strategy; confirmed entry count, filled quantity, and last add fill come from execution

stop_state.usage: stop formula uses a confirmed fill anchor; execution owns order/fill/flat transition

risk_unit.usage: configured notional equity remains a sizing input; execution owns accepted and filled size

position_state.usage: pending decision shadow prevents duplicate signals while an intent is outstanding

fill_assumption.current: TurtleTraderEngine._open/_add/_flat mutate a decision book on the signal bar and TradeAction.fill_price carries the theoretical channel/stop/gap price
fill_assumption.target: the same decision plan is emitted; StrategyStateAdapter tracks pending quantities and reconciles actual position, quantity, entry count, and anchors only from fills

price_source.breakout_trigger: prior Donchian channel plus/minus min_point, with gap-to-open rule
price_source.add_trigger: last decision/fill anchor plus/minus 0.5N, with gap-to-open rule
price_source.stop_trigger: last decision/fill anchor plus/minus 2N, with gap-to-open rule
price_source.actual_fill: FillRecord.price after configured latency and slippage
